title: Membership card reads as a status object, not a payment card
summary: The member number is shown as a labelled detail (“Member no.”) in the interface typeface instead of spaced monospace digits, and a visible caption “Membership card — not a payment card” sits under the card.
migration: `className` now applies to the outer figure (card + caption); width classes behave the same. New optional prop `caption` (default true). Optional app follow-up: format numbers as “No. 1A2B3C4D” in memberNumberFor (passport-view.ts).
